JW-ias.why: Jewel of Fervor = +15% Increased Attack Speed (prop 457; 15 is the only roll seen, 52/259 jewels carry it). Asks: plain 15 IAS min 2.58 Ist (Vex), median 11.4 - far above the d2io guide band ('15% IAS = Pul', >2x, flagged) and above the d2io buyer who pays 'PUL for each 15 IAS/60-69 AR ... GUL for 15 IAS/100 AR' and the seller 'Jewel of Fervor +15% IAS LF Pul or Lem'. Read: Traderie asks for plain IAS are inflated; Pul-Um is the realistic band. Trash line: IAS < 15 does not occur; a 15 IAS jewel with a junk prefix is still Pul.

This only works for the Character holding the Charm' and 'Your Character also loses a LARGE amount of Resistance of the same type' (base: Cold/Fire/Lightning/Poison Resist -70 to -90, Magic Resist -45 to -65 for Black Cleft, Damage Increased by 10-20% for Bone Break) - maxroll Sunder Charms (2026-05-22). RotW: 'the ability to upgrade them with up to 5 additional Affixes ... chosen from 5 groups ... Each group can only exist once': Latent <charm> + Perfect gem + rune + Worldstone Shard(s) -> Renewed <charm> (Rotting Fissure: P.Emerald + Ko + Western shard; Cold Rupture: P.Sapphire + Lum + Eastern; Crack of the Heavens: P.Topaz + Fal + Southern; Flame Rift: P.Ruby + Io + Deep; Bone Break: P.Amethyst + Pul + Northern; Black Cleft: P.Diamond + Mal + Southern + Deep + Northern shards). Affix groups: [element] 5-15% skill dmg OR -5-10% enemy res (Bone Break: +75-100% ED OR -5-10% enemy phys res); [MF/GF] 14-25% MF OR 20-55% GF; [life/mana] 10-65 life OR 10-75 mana; [utility] 5-10 FRW OR 12-24 FHR OR +3-8 all attributes; [defence] MDR 5-10 OR DR 5-10. Three price tiers follow: BASE ('The ...', 3 in-scope variants seen on Traderie): 0.2-1 Ist for fire/cold/poison/lightning (Lem-Ist asks; fill 'Bone Break 11% -> 1 Ist'), magic/physical asks median 9.3 but min Mal-Um. LATENT (the crafting input): priced by the Renewed output it can make - poison 0.4-0.8, cold 1-2.6, fire 2.6-4 (fill: Latent Flame Rift -89 -> 1 Ist), lightning 9.3-11.4, magic 9.3-11.4, physical 18.6-22.8 (2 Ber); d2io swap ads confirm the order ('My Latent Fire/Poison for your Latent Lightning / Magic / Physical'). RENEWED: the roll decides everything - -10% enemy res (max) with life/MF/DR near max sells for 5-35 Jah (fills: Renewed Flame Rift -10/24 FHR/49 mana/24 MF -> 15 Jah = 171 Ist; Renewed Black Cleft -10 magic/+8 attr/43 life/DR 7/25 MF -> 35 Jah = 400 Ist; perfect Renewed Cold Rupture 15% csd/25 MF/+7 attr -> 6 Jah; Renewed Flame Rift -10/24 FHR/39 life -> 5 Jah), mid rolls Lo-Ber (fills 1 Ber, 1 Ber, 1 Lo), low rolls Pul+Lem / 25 PGems / 2 P.Amethyst. Observed on every Renewed row: the self-resist penalty shows as -70% (the minimum of the base range) - the maxroll page does not state this, treat as observed. Why the element order: magic and physical immunities are otherwise unbreakable (Immunities page: 'Magic Resistance cannot be reduced in any way'), lightning is the most-played S-tier element (Light/Nova sorc, LF/LS amazon, Lightning Sentry), and the -enemy-res affix on a Renewed charm works at 100% on sundered monsters while Conviction/Lower Resist drop to 1/5 (Immunities page).
